resources.string:
Effective Date: 2026-09-20
We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what data AnimeTrack collects and how it is used and protected. By using this app, you agree to this policy.
# 1. Information We Collect
**Local data (never leaves your device by default)**
- Anime tracking records, watch progress, ratings and notes - Appearance and feature preferences - Local logs (app behavior and exceptions only, kept for 3 days, no sensitive personal data)
The data above is stored on your device and is never uploaded unless you explicitly enable sync or export.
**Account data (only after registration and login)**
- Username and email address (for login, verification codes and password recovery) - Password (encrypted on the server; we cannot see the plaintext) - Device information (device ID, name, platform), used for multi-device login management and account security
**Cloud data (only after login and sync)**
- Cloud anime tracking records, for syncing across devices - Feedback records (your feedback and our replies)
# 2. How Data Is Used
- To provide cloud sync of tracking records and multi-device login - To process and reply to your feedback - Local logs are uploaded as an attachment only when you submit feedback, for troubleshooting
# 3. Third-Party Services
This app communicates with the following third-party services, each governed by its own privacy policy:
- **Bangumi / TMDB**: anime metadata and ratings - **Bilibili**: syncing your watch list after you actively log in - **GitHub**: checking for app updates - **Hitokoto**: random quotes - **WebDAV**: a sync server configured by yourself; the data never passes through us
# 4. Permissions
- **Notifications**: used only for anime update reminders; can be disabled at any time
# 5. Data Storage and Security
- Account data is transmitted over HTTPS; passwords are stored encrypted - Local logs are automatically cleaned up after 3 days - We never sell or share your personal data with unrelated third parties
# 6. Data Deletion
- After logging out, your cloud tracking records are retained and can be restored by logging in again - Account deletion: there is a 7-day cooling-off period after submission, during which logging back in cancels the request; after that, your account information, cloud tracking records and feedback records are permanently deleted
# 7. Policy Updates
We may revise this policy from time to time and will notify you in the app. Continued use means you accept the revised policy.
# 8. Contact Us
If you have any questions, reach us via:
- GitHub: https://github.com/AieXile/AnimeTrack - Telegram: https://t.me/AnimeTrackovo - In-app feedback
